_doc: P3356 ratchet on the packed upload archive (exact Homey CLI tar stream: scripts/ci/upload-archive-ceiling.cjs). Top level = final upload dir after npm ci --omit=dev and prune (homey-app-publish action, blocking). appOnly = same dir without node_modules (Platform Budget, blocking). Lower when the archive shrinks; raise only with a reviewed reason added to history.

history.baseline: Port of the master P3356/P3360 blocking file-count ratchet (Athom #488). Values start at master's cap (maxFiles 3830 / maxTarBytes 32700000) as an upper safety bound.
history.afterTrim: Includes P3360 lossless packaged driver-image dedupe. Ratchet down after the next packed measurement on this branch.
history.headroom: Upper bound copied from master; not a claim that this branch's archive is that large

history.baseline: build #3716 v9.0.1635 upload dir: 3740 files, tar 32040960 B (30.56 MB); pre-upload-guard 3739 files, 27.14 MB, 347 drivers

history.headroom: maxFiles 3830 / maxTarBytes 32700000 unchanged; expected file count drops after image dedupe, then rises when 27 graduated drivers ship
